memories.content: The user wants Rust library crates to use the thiserror crate for their error types, and Rust binaries to use the anyhow crate for error handling — never swapped (no anyhow in library public APIs, no thiserror boilerplate in binaries).

Mixing up the thiserror/anyhow convention (thiserror for libraries, anyhow for binaries) has caused problems for the user's team twice already, which is why it's a hard rule rather than a stylistic preference.
